newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trade surplus rising in real terms -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade surplus rising in real terms -- BOJ.

text.p: Japan's trade surplus has been rising since last autumn in real terms, with exports on a rising trend due partly to the weakening of the yen, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said in a monthly economic report on Tuesday.
helping slow the pace of growth in imports.
The Japanese economy continues to recover moderately with private demand becoming firmer, it said.
Capital spending has been steadily increasingly, while housing investment remains brisk, the BOJ said.
The report said production is increasing, led by a substantial rise in car production.
It added that short- and long-term bank lending rates have been moving at historically low levels.
